ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with approximately 8-12% high-intensity (white/light grey) coverage localized to distal tips and surface scarring.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Distinct circular light-grey blobs (rosettes) positioned in the upper-right quadrant of the right lobe. Sparse, thin-line circular outlines distributed across the central-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 55 degrees; notch depth occupies approximately 15% of the vertical height of the visible fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing edge; multiple irregular peaks and valleys, most pronounced on the outer thirds of both lobes; edge is smoother approaching the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Generally convex curve sweep from the notch to the distal tips, with significant irregularity at the tips due to biological encrustation.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of three prominent circular, multi-toned light-grey clusters on the upper-right lobe. Multiple faint, thin-ring circular scars distributed across the mid-left lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One distinct vertical high-contrast white linear scratch on the mid-left lobe; several smaller, less defined linear marks near the bottom center of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense barnacle colonization (Coronula diadema) on the distal tips of both lobes, appearing as high-contrast, jagged white/grey masses; multiple depigmented circular lesions on the surface area of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: The right distal tip exhibits extreme barnacle encrustation that significantly alters the geometric profile, creating a bulbous, 'club-like' appearance compared to the left tip.
